model.name: Poolside Laguna S 2.1
model.quant: Q4_K_M with resident planar-qmicro Q6_K selected down

candidate.scope: production Q6 planar-qmicro integer-WMMA selected down; D4 activation; 64 output columns x 64 routed rows; local128
candidate.premise: load each result row's float scale and packed pair of int16 K16 sums in lanes 0 and 16, then broadcast them within each wave32 instead of issuing the same LDS reads from all 16 column lanes
candidate.invariants: resident weights, activation quantization, WMMA fragments, -32*sum(x) correction, ordered FP32 K32 accumulation, and BF16 stores remain unchanged

correctness.red: The production-shaped uneven/empty-expert test initially failed because the wrapper had no result-metadata broadcast selector.
correctness.green: The distinct exact specialization passed the production-shaped CPU-reference fixture.
correctness.post_removal_command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -m pytest -q 'tests/test_gguf_q4_k_q8_1_selected_prefill.py::test_q6_k_t16_ds4x3_f32_mmq64x32_matches_cpu_quality_gate' tests/test_laguna_moe_gpu.py::test_laguna_model_moe_plan_resolves_production_contract_on_gfx1151 tests/test_laguna_moe_gpu.py::test_laguna_mmq_selected_down_reuses_exact_grouped_combine

actual_weight_layer1_leaf.command: HIP_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 HIPENGINE_HIP_ARCH=gfx1151 GPU_MAX_HW_QUEUES=1 HIPENGINE_COMPILER_VERSION_FILE=/tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt HIPENGINE_REQUIRE_CACHED_BUILD=1 PYTHONPATH=. .venv/bin/python3 -u scripts/laguna_q6_qmicro_leaf.py --samples 21 --warmups 3 --prefill-burst 7 --decode-burst 20 --compiler-version-file /tmp/laguna_hipcc_version.txt --require-cached-build --output /tmp/laguna-q6-wmma-broadcast-metadata-leaf-21-v2.json
actual_weight_layer1_leaf.timing: HIP events; activation packing excluded; counter-rotated over fourteen modes; burst seven

decision.reason: Two wave shuffles per result row cost far more than gfx1151 same-address LDS service; the candidate loses every pair and regresses the exact leaf by 40.46%.
decision.action: Remove the HIP specialization, export, wrapper selector, CPU-reference parameter, and leaf-harness mode. Preserve direct LDS result-metadata reads in the production activation-hoist kernel.
decision.next: Screen a WMMA-specific K64 schedule only if it preserves the existing single K32 LDS footprint and zero scratch; do not repeat the rejected double-stage K64 design.
